data.title: Stern test from within
data.description: Less than four months after taking office, the government appears to be confronting the greatest threat to its survival -- not from an emboldened opposition, but from mounting pressures within its own ranks.

data.title: Govt shows unity amid rumours
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and Pheu Thai leader Julapun Amornvivat put on a public display of unity on Tuesday, dismissing speculation the ruling coalition could fracture ahead of an expected no-confidence debate later this year.

data.title: Min Aung Hlaing talks to address bilateral challenges
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar are preparing to to discuss border security, transnational crime, trade recovery and peace efforts during Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing’s official visit to Thailand on Thursday and Friday.

data.title: Tiger attack on ranger only ‘second in 28 years’
data.description: A tiger that killed and dragged away a park ranger in Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary was behind only the second known attack of its kind in 28 years, and the behaviour was not typical of the species, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said on Wednesday.

data.title: Three state agency accounts frozen after vehicle data leaks
data.description: Three government agency user accounts with access to the Ministry of Transport database have been suspended after authorities detected suspicious activities, Deputy Transport Minister Siripong Angkasakulkiat said on Wednesday.

data.title: Cabinet backs revised Myanmar labour pact
data.description: Revised labour agreements with Myanmar are aimed at strengthening protections for migrant workers and ensuring cross-border recruitment is conducted through legal channels, a deputy government spokesperson said on Wednesday.

data.title: Two suspects in Tak Bai police killings shot dead
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Two suspects linked to the fatal shooting of two Tak Bai police officers were killed in a gunfight with security forces in this southern province on Wednesday, while authorities later apprehended another suspect believed to have helped the duo evade arrest earlier.

data.title: Chinese envoy urged to understand Thai sensitivities
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has urged the Chinese ambassador in Bangkok to promote mutual understanding, and not just one-sided protection of Chinese interests.

data.title: Thai radiation detector joins moon probe
data.description: The National Astronomical Research Institute of Thailand (Narit) said a Thai-made cosmic radiation detector will be attached to China's Chang'e 7 orbiter, scheduled to launch this month.

data.title: FM: Chinese ambassador should create understanding, not protect only Chinese interest
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow has urged the Chinese ambassador in Bangkok to promote mutual understanding, not one-sided protection of Chinese interest.

data.title: New framework for senior schools
data.description: New nationwide criteria for establishing senior citizen schools have been published in the Royal Gazette, Deputy Government Spokesperson Capt Patdarasm Thongsaluaykorn said on Tuesday.

data.title: Thai footballer killed by lightning during Golok FA Cup
data.description: NARATHIWAT - A Thai footballer was killed after being struck by lightning during a match in this southern province on Tuesday, while nine others were injured.

data.title: People's Party rejects claims of harassment cover-up
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) has rejected allegations that it pressured a former lawmaker to remain silent after she reported being sexually harassed by a fellow member of its predecessor, the Move Forward Party (MFP).

data.title: Tiger suspected of mauling park ranger close to living quarters
data.description: A park ranger was found mauled in the Huai Kha Khaeng Wildlife Sanctuary in Uthai Thani province on Wednesday morning and officials assumed he was attacked by a tiger near his living quarters.

data.title: Bangkok council chief issues warning over vote-card misuse
data.description: The chair of the Bangkok Metropolitan Council (BMC) has warned that councillors found guilty of serious ethical violations over alleged vote-card misuse could face removal from office, as the council begins reviewing complaints over the alleged misconduct.

data.title: Fixes sought for missing person cases
data.description: The Mirror Foundation has urged the Royal Thai Police (RTP) to overhaul Thailand's missing persons tracking system by adopting six key measures.

data.title: Mor Prom app data errors investigated
data.description: Over 7,000 people have complained about inaccurate medical records on the Mor Prom app, prompting the Public Health Ministry to pledge legal action against anyone deliberately entering false data.

data.title: Manhunt for cop killers widens
data.description: A manhunt for six suspects accused of killing two police officers in Narathiwat has intensified after investigators found evidence suggesting they may have fled across the border.

data.title: Two agencies join data leak investigation
data.description: Two government agencies have launched a joint investigation after vehicle registration and personal data were circulated online, although authorities say the source of the apparent leak has yet to be identified.

data.title: People's Party rejects claims of harassment cover-up
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) has rejected allegations that it pressured a former lawmaker to remain silent after she reported being sexually harassed by a fellow member of its predecessor, the Move Forward Party (MFP).

data.title: Vlogger's body in Turkey
data.description: The body of Thai travel YouTuber Bawornthat "Hlun Solo" Pengsuk has reached the Thai embassy in Ankara, Turkey, with repatriation to Thailand expected soon after the final documentation has been completed.

data.title: DSI moves against forex suspects
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has formally charged four people, including People's Party (PP) list MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom "Film" Tokongsup, in connection with an alleged online forex investment scheme.

data.title: Temple manuscripts preserved
data.description: The Fine Arts Department has completed a major conservation project at Wat Chakkrawat Rachawat Woramahawihan, uncovering one of Bangkok's most significant collections of historic manuscripts.

data.title: Builders say migrants needed
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has met with representatives of the Thai Contractors Association under His Majesty the King's Patronage (TCA) to address the growing shortage of foreign workers.

data.title: PM pushes deeper Indonesia relations
data.description: Thailand and Indonesia signed four agreements on Tuesday covering tourism, carbon markets and economic cooperation during Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul's official two-day visit to Jakarta, the first by a Thai premier in 15 years.

data.title: Myanmar keen to boost ties
data.description: Myanmar President Min Aung Hlaing is scheduled to arrive in Thailand on Thursday for a two day visit, marking his first trip here since becoming a civilian leader.
